seriesName: ASA Computers listed prices for current-generation NVIDIA/PNY GPU cards
notes: All four prices are 'Our Price' listings pulled directly from ASA Computers' own product pages on the same date the H200 bullet was captured (2026-09-09); ASA does not date-stamp the page itself, so publishedAt reflects the day these listings were observed live. This contextualizes the H200's $30,999.00 price by showing where it sits relative to other current GPU cards ASA sells (L40S, RTX 5090, RTX 6000 Ada) -- the H200 is priced far above ASA's workstation/prosumer cards and roughly in line with prior-gen H100 pricing on the same site. Two additional ASA listings (PNY RTX 5000 Ada $4,152.00, PNY RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell $4,469.00) were seen on the category page but were not individually re-verified on their own product pages, so they were left out to keep every point independently confirmed.
